mapper.select: SELECT sip.code AS planCode, io.batch_no AS batchNo, io.order_no AS orderNo, io.create_time AS requestTime, tpTask.experiment_type AS experimentType, tpTask.storage_condition AS storageCondition, tpTask.time_value AS timeValue, tpTask.time_unit AS timeUnit, t.inspect_item_id AS inspectItemId, ii.code AS inspectItemCode, ii.name AS inspectItemName, ip.id AS parameterId, ssdp.version_id AS schemeVersionId, ip.code AS parameterCode, ip.name AS parameterName, ssdp.id AS dataPointId, ssdp.name AS dataPointName, ssdp.point_type AS pointType, ier.value_text AS valueText, ier.value_number AS valueNumber, ier.test_time AS testTime FROM lm_inspection_entry_record ier INNER JOIN lm_task t ON ier.task_id = t.id AND t.is_deleted = 0 INNER JOIN lm_inspection_order io ON t.inspection_order_id = io.id AND io.is_deleted = 0 INNER JOIN lm_stability_scheme_version ssv ON io.scheme_version_id = ssv.id AND ssv.is_deleted = 0 INNER JOIN lm_stability_plan_timepoint_task tpTask ON tpTask.inspection_order_id = io.id AND tpTask.is_deleted = 0 INNER JOIN lm_stability_inspect_plan sip ON tpTask.plan_id = sip.id AND sip.is_deleted = 0 INNER JOIN lm_stability_scheme_data_point ssdp ON ier.data_point_config_id = ssdp.id AND ssdp.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN lm_inspect_item ii ON t.inspect_item_id = ii.id AND ii.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN lm_inspect_parameter ip ON ssdp.parameter_id = ip.id AND ip.is_deleted = 0 WHERE ier.is_deleted = 0 AND io.order_status IN ('CONFIRMED', 'SAMPLE_AUDIT_PENDING', 'SAMPLE_AUDIT_REJECTED', 'COMPLETED') AND sip.id = #{query.planId} AND tpTask.experiment_type = #{query.experimentType} AND tpTask.storage_condition = #{query.storageCondition} ORDER BY tpTask.time_value, tpTask.time_unit, ii.code, ip.code, ssdp.name
SELECT id, code, status FROM lm_stability_inspect_plan WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND material_id = #{materialId} AND status != 'PENDING' ORDER BY code

SELECT DISTINCT experiment_type AS experimentType, storage_condition AS storageCondition FROM lm_stability_plan_timepoint_task WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND plan_id = #{planId} ORDER BY experiment_type, storage_condition

SELECT m.name AS materialName, m.code AS materialCode, m.specification AS materialSpec, ss.id AS schemeId, ss.name AS schemeName FROM lm_stability_inspect_plan sip INNER JOIN lm_inspect_material m ON sip.material_id = m.id AND m.is_deleted = 0 INNER JOIN lm_stability_scheme_version ssv ON sip.scheme_version_id = ssv.id AND ssv.is_deleted = 0 INNER JOIN lm_stability_scheme ss ON ssv.scheme_id = ss.id AND ss.is_deleted = 0 WHERE sip.id = #{query.planId} AND sip.is_deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
